rationale: unit:given.syntax introduces nested Value constructors; unit:given.evaluation defines left-to-right evaluation and allocation; unit:given.steps defines a complete statement step. The selected nested_constructor proposition is one Step from empty storage with the single let b = new Box(new Token()) to nestedState and []. The Examples context defines the same Token/Box class table and nestedState with Token 0, Box 1 whose value is some 0, and only b = some 1. This checks both the complete one-step execution and the absence of any temporary source variable, while the evaluation rule establishes that the inner token is evaluated before the box allocation.
limitations: This is a correspondence comparison of the frozen prose, exact selected statements/definitions, and identified semantic context. No Lean build, test execution, or proof-tactic audit was performed; compilation and evidence validation are separate checks.

Listed full-source context snapshots were consulted for the supporting declarations and example states discussed in the rationale and dependency comparisons; the listing does not claim examination of every unrelated proof or declaration in those files.
